transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together because the parent company has requested a $4,000,000 special dividend from Northstar Components before the end of the third quarter. The draft request currently has no finalized payment date or supporting process terms. As you all know, Northstar has $8,600,000 of cash available for distribution after its ordinary operating payments, so the funds are there — but before I sign off on any distribution instruction, I need to walk through the standard treasury approval routine with all of you: liquidity planning, legal, and tax. I'd like to hear each of your perspectives so we can determine the right payment date and process terms before I make my final authorization decision.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I completed the subsidiary's cash forecast this morning. The largest authorized dividend payment that preserves the required $5,000,000 post-distribution operating reserve is exactly $3,600,000 — that's the gross authorized dividend before any withholding is remitted. The forecast supports paying it on September 30, 2026. I should note the draft request of $4,000,000 would leave only $4,600,000 in cash, which falls below the $5,000,000 reserve requirement. I haven't yet circulated the updated forecast, but I'm sharing it with all of you now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a legal requirement I discovered this week while reviewing the subsidiary's corporate file. Under Northstar Components' articles, any distribution above $3,000,000 requires a signed solvency certificate from two directors before payment can be made. This requirement is not yet on the transaction checklist, so we'll need to add it to the process terms before any distribution instruction is signed.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share an important tax requirement. I confirmed in a tax memo received this morning that the dividend requires a 5% withholding reserve, and that the withheld amount must be remitted within 10 business days after payment. The memo has not yet been attached to the distribution file, but I'm bringing it to everyone's attention now so we can factor it into the process terms and payment date.
transcript.speaker: A4
